skill.description: Guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through README-first reproduction of deep learning repositories. It selects minimal documented targets, plans setup, runs only authorized commands, and records evidence in a standardized output bundle.

security_audit.summary: Most static backtick and reconnaissance hits are false positives from Markdown or status text. Confirmed risks remain for README-derived command execution and parent-directory reference loading. No prompt injection text was found in the reviewed cited files.

remediation.issue: README-derived commands can execute inside the target repository.
remediation.suggestion: Show the exact command and repository path, then require explicit confirmation before any execution path runs.

remediation.issue: The skill references parent-directory files outside its package.
remediation.suggestion: Move required reference documents inside the skill package or resolve only validated marketplace-owned paths.

remediation.issue: Execution guidance depends on external companion scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Document required companion scripts and fail closed when expected scripts are missing or outside the trusted skill set.

content.value_statement: Research reproduction often fails when agents skip evidence, run broad commands, or alter protocol. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through README-first reproduction with auditable outputs.
actual_capabilities: Reads README and repository signals to select the smallest documented reproduction target.
Plans environment, dataset, checkpoint, and cache assumptions before execution.
Optionally runs a selected documented command with timeouts and captured output.
Records verified facts, assumptions, deviations, and human decisions in repro_outputs.
Supports training startup verification, resume metadata, and explicit full-training authorization.
limitations: Does not prove full paper reproduction from smoke tests or startup runs.
Repository commands run only after request, but untrusted repositories remain risky.
Requires companion skill scripts expected in the same repository layout.
May need user-provided datasets, checkpoints, credentials, or compute resources.

use_cases.title: Triage a New AI Repository
use_cases.description: Identify the smallest documented command that can support a trustworthy reproduction attempt.

use_cases.title: Review Reproduction Evidence
use_cases.description: Compare README-backed commands, run logs, assumptions, and deviations before accepting results.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Handoff Bundle
use_cases.description: Create standardized notes that another researcher can inspect and continue safely.

prompt_templates.title: Start Minimal Reproduction
prompt_templates.prompt: Reproduce the smallest documented target for this repository. Read the README first, choose a minimal command, and write the repro_outputs bundle.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Failed Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the failed reproduction evidence. Separate README-backed steps from inferred fixes, then list blockers and the safest next action.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Training Startup
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the documented training command with startup verification only. Do not claim full reproduction without explicit authorization and sufficient evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve Paper Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare README evidence with the paper only where reproduction depends on it. Record conflicts, assumptions, and human decisions in the output bundle.

output_examples.input: A user asks to reproduce a vision model repository with README examples.
output: Selected the documented inference target as the smallest trustworthy run.
Captured setup assumptions, command source, execution status, and remaining blockers.
Wrote a concise repro_outputs bundle for review.

output_examples.input: A user asks whether a training repository is ready for full reproduction.
output: Completed training startup verification instead of claiming full reproduction.
Recorded dataset and checkpoint uncertainty for human review.
Requested explicit approval before any longer training run.

output_examples.input: A repository has no clear runnable command in the README.
output: Stopped at repository intake and documented the missing command evidence.
Listed candidate files and assumptions without treating them as verified protocol.

best_practices: Run inside an isolated environment before executing repository commands.
Keep README evidence separate from inferred setup or patch decisions.
Require human approval before full training or protocol-sensitive changes.
anti_patterns: Using the skill as a general paper summarizer.
Treating a smoke test as full scientific reproduction.
Editing model, data, or metric logic without recording comparability impact.

faq.question: What repositories does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports AI repositories with README instructions, scripts, configs, or documented commands.

faq.question: Does it run code automatically?
faq.answer: Execution is optional and controlled by the user. Untrusted repository commands still require caution.

faq.question: Can it verify full paper reproduction?
faq.answer: It can gather evidence, but full reproduction requires sufficient runs, data, compute, and human review.

faq.question: What outputs does it produce?
faq.answer: It writes summary, commands, logs, comparability notes, scientific changes, status, and patch records.

faq.question: Can it patch broken repositories?
faq.answer: It allows conservative fixes only when needed, and records the reason and research impact.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
